commonDeclarationAndHelpers.evidence: Ordinary authoring, strict source/path binding, shared default questions, immutable sessions, structural sidecar validation, telemetry, hash-bound review, and offline replay operated across all panels. All 27 observed units reached correct decisions.
commonDeclarationAndHelpers.boundary: P shares much of this support and there is no unsupported-platform control, so the 27 correct decisions cannot be attributed to the DSL or helper stack alone. Deterministic checks prove reproducibility and sensitivity, not semantic improvement.
